title: Stage-2 per-sender stamp omits stage-1's applied-sender guard; APPLIED_SINCE_LOAD untested
evidence:
mark_reminder_for_sender.sql ends with:
  AND lower(sender_email) NOT IN (
    SELECT lower(email) FROM application WHERE vacancy_id = $1
  )
mark_followup_for_sender.sql ends with only:
  AND lower(sender_email) IN (
    SELECT sender_email_lc
    FROM inbound_email_sender_state
    WHERE vacancy_id = $1
      AND stage2_due
  )
— no NOT IN application clause. The new test functions are: mark_reminder_for_sender_stamps_only_the_named_email_test, mark_followup_for_sender_respects_the_gate_test, single_applicant_remind_reports_stage1_count_test, single_applicant_remind_reports_stage2_count_when_due_test, single_applicant_remind_reports_zero_when_already_fully_reminded_test, single_applicant_remind_cross_tenant_returns_404_test, single_applicant_remind_closed_vacancy_returns_404_test, single_applicant_remind_re_enquiry_sends_stage1_not_stage2_test, single_applicant_remind_rejects_malformed_body_test, single_applicant_remind_rejects_empty_email_test, single_applicant_remind_rejects_invalid_email_test — none exercises an applied sender.
detail: Stage 1 excludes applied senders with an explicit NOT IN application clause; stage 2 omits it, relying solely on stage2_due. No integration test pins the APPLIED_SINCE_LOAD case for this endpoint — the applied-exclusion invariant is undefended.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test where the enquirer applies before the remind click; assert {0,0} and no send. If stage2_due doesn't exclude applied senders, add the same NOT IN application guard to mark_followup_for_sender.sql.

title: Both-zero toast asserts 'already had both reminders' but both-zero also covers applied-since-load
evidence:
0, 0 -> "They've already had both reminders."
Spec I/O matrix row in the same diff:
| APPLIED_SINCE_LOAD | enquirer applied after list loaded | Both marks exclude applied email (view + NOT IN application) → `{0,0}`, 200 | N/A |
detail: The 0,0 toast arm also fires for applied-since-load (per the spec's I/O matrix), not only when fully reminded. In that case the landlord is told a falsehood — the person applied, they didn't 'already have both reminders.'
recommended_fix: Use vaguer copy for the 0,0 arm (e.g. 'No reminder needed.') that holds across all both-zero causes, or split the applied-since-load cause from the fully-reminded case.
